taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station BMGS-bori-field, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1005 | 3.42 | 3.42
2 | 3588 | 6.33 | 9.76
3 | 1358 | 10.9 | 20.7
4 | 333 | 9.08 | 29.7
5 | 2950 | 36.8 | 66.5
6 | 5469 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KQHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station BMGS-bori-field, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station BMGS-bori-field, Bori Metropolis**

The vertical electrical sounding at this station resolves six layers. Resistivity decreases then increases irregularly with depth: Layer 1 (1005 Ω·m, 3.42 m) is overlain by a highly resistive Layer 2 (3588 Ω·m, to 9.76 m), followed by a decreasing sequence through Layer 3 (1358 Ω·m, to 20.7 m) and Layer 4 (333 Ω·m, to 29.7 m), then a strong increase through Layer 5 (2950 Ω·m, to 66.5 m) into a highly resistive basal Layer 6 (5469 Ω·m).

Applying the standard curve-type convention to successive triplets: (1-2-3) 1005<3588>1358 → K; (2-3-4) 3588>1358>333 → Q; (3-4-5) 1358>333<2950 → H; (4-5-6) 333<2950<5469 → A. This yields KQHA, consistent with the filed classification. No discrepancy was found between the resistivity values and the stated curve type.

{"curve_type_stated": "KQHA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
